model.name: FILE SELECTORS (full-path + open-chooser, reuse RbFileTree)
model.description: Each pane has a file selector: a full-path selector above left + right, and a merged-path selector in the center, each with an 'open file chooser' button that browses the project tree via RbFileTree (reused from R30.5).
model.tronQuote: > TRON 2026-07-13 (R30.6 sub-feature): FILE SELECTORS (full-path + open-chooser, reuse RbFileTree).

discoverySource.note: R30.6 sub-feature (2/5) of the 3-way diff/merge editor. Scenario-first; planner tasks T30.6.2.

model.crossRefNote: 3-way diff/merge editor (R30.6 umbrella) to resolve the OOSH version issue. Class DiffMergeEditor (architect wires). Reuses RbFileTree (R30.5) for the file chooser.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A full-path selector above left + right, and a merged-path selector in the center pane.
Each selector has an 'open file chooser' button that browses the project tree, REUSING RbFileTree (R30.5) for the tree browse.
